baselines.name: DNA-SaM

paper.citation: Wang et al., Towards scalable DNA data storage with DNA-SaM codec system, Nature Communications 17, 11772 (19 October 2026)

architecture: Address, file-attribute and XOR metadata strands
Single-base edit correction and XOR recovery

reported_metrics.coverage_for_complete_recovery: 20x minimum under specific reported in-vitro conditions for most tested datasets
reported_metrics.in_vivo_large_image_wet_validation_scope: one randomly selected unit, not the whole multi-unit image corpus

source_discrepancies.manuscript_claim: 42,560 valid words; 32,768 data codewords; 9,792 replacement codewords
source_discrepancies.repository_readme_claim: 42,560 valid words; 37,768 data codewords; 9,792 replacement codewords
source_discrepancies.consequence: README partition sums to 47,560 and exceeds its own valid-word total by 5,000; resolve against publication-associated Zenodo archive and exact source before any reproduced density claim.

reproduction_blockers: Pin the exact publication-associated archive and compare it with repository HEAD.
Reproduce the paper's in-silico baseline under its original runtime and data definitions.
Separate read coverage, molecule copy count and unique molecule count.
Reproduce in-vitro data only where lawful data access and laboratory resources permit.
baselines.evidence_boundary: The >2^70 PB system capacity is theoretical. One hundred generations of plasmid passaging is an in-vivo stability experiment under the specific tested biological protocol, not an ordinary media-retention lifetime result.

baselines.name: Siyuan Code

paper.citation: Li et al., Towards density-optimal DNA storage with practical bijective coding, Nature Communications 17, 10261 (27 August 2026)
paper.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for article text and applicable figures; does not grant permission to redistribute adapted material.

source.simulator_license: README states simulator is public but without a license

architecture: Trie-based catalog of forbidden sequence motifs
Dynamic programming / enumerative bijective mapping to suitable sequences
reproduction_blockers: No root LICENSE file was found at the observed repository HEAD; do not assume an open-source license.
The README identifies a modified MESA simulator with no license; do not redistribute or bundle it without permission.
Resolve sample, raw-read and encoded-data reuse rights.
Pin source and dependencies; reproduce the exact six-copy and sequencing protocol before comparing against other copy/read budgets.
Audit complete strand/index/checksum/ECC/primer overhead before accepting the reported net density.
baselines.evidence_boundary: The 41 EB/g, 1.66 bits/nt, ~1 MB/s and six-copy retrieval are paper-reported values under the study's in-vitro conditions. They are not Luminous measurements or guaranteed general operating points.

baselines.name: Cross-system comparison policy
rules: Do not compare molecule copies per strand with sequencing reads per strand.
Do not compare pre-primer or pre-index bit density with full net payload bits per nucleotide.
Do not count PCR duplicates as independent molecule copies.
Keep in-silico, paper-reproduction, in-vitro and in-vivo evidence classes separate.
All decoded files are evaluated by an independent byte-exact scorer and out-of-band digest.
No paper's sample-size, data-rights or protocol limitations may be silently omitted.
